# Browse

Who: everyone. Data: published stories.
Next id: REQ-BRW-003

## Cards

- **REQ-BRW-001** A story card shows a "NEW" badge for 7 days after the story is published. [AB-1]
  Why: people come back to see what is new.
- **REQ-BRW-002** When a written card is too narrow for the badge beside the heart, the card's top line moves below the heart. (planned) [AB-1]
  Example: a narrow column with large text.
  Not: hiding the badge.
